% Commands of TeX Live's restricted shell escape list (shell_escape_commands
% in texmf.cnf: kpsewhich, makeindex, ...). With restricted shell escape
% (TeX Live's default) they run; texrun disables shell escape entirely, so
% they must not. makeindex would write shell-escape-marker.ind.
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\immediate\write18{kpsewhich -version}
\immediate\write18{makeindex -q -o shell-escape-marker.ind entries.idx}
Text.
\end{document}
